description: This file contains implementation of loop nest randomization functions for tensor expression optimization in PyTorch JIT, including loop transformations, nested loop analysis, and randomization utilities.

methods.name: max_transformations
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of transformations allowed based on environment variable.

methods.name: GetAllPerfectlyNestedLoopNests
methods.description: Finds all sets of perfectly nested loops within a list of loops.

methods.name: select_n_randomly
methods.description: Selects n random elements from a vector.

methods.name: find_factor
methods.description: Finds a valid factor for loop tiling.

methods.name: printHistory
methods.description: Logs transformation steps with an index and message.

methods.name: loopnestRandomization
methods.description: Performs randomized loop transformations for tensor expression optimization.
